title: Weeping Plague Bird
description: A large surreal bird-like creature with a long beak and colorful tears streaming from its red eye dominates the scene. Below it, on a dark mound, stand several small crowned figures in robes performing a ritual around a flaming bird idol, surrounded by scattered gold coins and artifacts.
prompt: surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a giant plague doctor bird with feathered wings, ornate golden crown and horns, and a long beak from which multicolored tears drip down. The bird overlooks a group of small robed cultists with crowns standing on a dark mound performing a ritual around a burning phoenix idol, with scattered gold coins and artifacts on the ground, ink and watercolor style with bokeh background
